metadata.name: languato-whiteboard
metadata.description: A standalone collaborative whiteboard (Fabric.js) split out of the meeting-room component: drawing tools, shapes, multi-page, lock-for-student, and PNG export. Networking is NOT built in - it emits and receives update messages that the host page relays through another component's data channel.
features: Pen, highlighter, eraser, laser pointer, text, sticky note, rectangle, circle, line tools
Color swatches plus custom color picker and stroke width slider
Undo/redo, clear, grid or lined background, image upload
Teacher-only lock that stops the student from drawing
Save the current page as a PNG to the user's own device
Emits an outbound message for every local change (sendUpdate) instead of talking to a server itself, so the host page can relay it over whatever channel it owns

properties.name: isTeacher
properties.description: Whether the current viewer is the teacher.

properties.name: locked
properties.description: When true, only the teacher can draw.

properties.name: accentColor
properties.description: Accent color for the active tool and lock button.

properties.name: savedState
properties.description: JSON string of a previously saved whiteboard state, loaded once on mount.

events.name: sendUpdate
events.description: Fires on every local drawing action.

events.name: changed
events.description: Fires whenever the whiteboard content changes, for persistence.

events.name: closeRequested
events.description: Fires when the user clicks the close button.

actions.label: Load Saved State
actions.description: Loads a previously saved whiteboard JSON state.

args.name: stateJson
args.description: JSON string of the saved state.

specifications: This component owns NO network connection.
The page is responsible for showing/hiding this component.
Give the root element a real height.
